AuctionPlayer.title: AuctionPlayer
AuctionPlayer.description: Represents a cricket player in the KPL 5 player auction with sold status, price, and team allocation

id.description: Unique identifier of the player (e.g., p_01)

name.description: Full display name of the player

soldStatus.description: Current state of the player in auction

teamId.description: Unique ID of the winning team if sold

teamName.description: Display name of the winning team if sold

updatedAt.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when the status was last changed

/kpl_auction_players/{playerId}.description: Live player auction roster synchronized between KPL Auction Control and KPL 5 Live Score App
